cases.title: Strength potion
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''Strength potion''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] that can be made by free-to-play players in addition to members. Both non-members and members can make a strength potion (4) by providing the [[Apothecary]] in [[Varrock]] with {{NoCoins|5}} coins, a [[limpwurt root]], and [[red spiders' eggs]]. Members who have attained at least level 12 [[Herblore]] additionally have the ability to use a [[limpwurt root]] on a [[tarromin potion (unf)]], yielding a Strength potion(3) and 50 Herblore [[experience]]. A dose of Strength potion provides a [[temporary skill boost]] to [[Strength]] equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down. This is less than the [[super Strength]]'s and [[super combat potion]]'s boost of 5 + 15% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: A '''Strength potion''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] that can be made by free-to-play players in addition to members. Both non-members and members can make a strength potion (4) by providing the [[Apothecary]] in [[Varrock]] with {{NoCoins|5}} coins, a [[limpwurt root]], and [[red spiders' eggs]]. Members who have attained at least level 12 [[Herblore]] additionally have the ability to use a [[limpwurt root]] on a [[tarromin potion (unf)]], yielding a Strength potion(3) and 50 Herblore [[experience]]. A dose of Strength potion provides a [[temporary skill boost]] to [[Strength]] equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down. This is less than the [[super Strength]]'s and [[super combat potion]]'s boost of 5 + 15% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down.
secondaryExcerpts: After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]], [[roe]] or [[caviar]] can be added to a Strength potion(2), requiring 14 Herblore, yielding a [[Strength mix]] and 17 Herblore experience. A Strength mix has 2 doses, boosts Strength equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down, and heals 3 [[Hitpoints]].

[[Category:Temporary skill boost]]
[[Category:Strength boosting items]]

==Effects==
Strength boost is calculated with: <math>\lfloor StrengthLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor + 3</math>

Stat boosts will decay at a rate of 1 point per minute, or 90 seconds with the use of [[Preserve]].

cases.title: Restore potion
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''restore potion''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[red spiders' eggs]] on a [[harralander potion (unf)]], requiring 22 [[Herblore]], yielding a restore potion(3) and 62.5 [[Herblore]] [[experience]]. A dose of restore potion restores levels of temporarily reduced stats in [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], [[Ranged]], and [[Magic]] equal to 10 + 30% of the related maximum level, rounded down, for each skill. It does '''not''' restore [[Prayer]] points or any other skill that is not listed like a [[super restore]]. Restore potions will '''not''' boost any skill above its base level, even if the listed restore is greater than the current reduction.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: A '''restore potion''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[red spiders' eggs]] on a [[harralander potion (unf)]], requiring 22 [[Herblore]], yielding a restore potion(3) and 62.5 [[Herblore]] [[experience]]. A dose of restore potion restores levels of temporarily reduced stats in [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], [[Ranged]], and [[Magic]] equal to 10 + 30% of the related maximum level, rounded down, for each skill. It does '''not''' restore [[Prayer]] points or any other skill that is not listed like a [[super restore]]. Restore potions will '''not''' boost any skill above its base level, even if the listed restore is greater than the current reduction.
secondaryExcerpts: After partial completion of the [[In Aid of the Myreque]] [[quest]], [[garlic]] can be added to a restore potion(3), requiring 22 Herblore, yielding a [[Guthix balance (unf)]] and 25 Herblore experience.

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]], [[roe]] or [[caviar]] can be added to a restore potion(2), requiring 24 Herblore, yielding a [[Restore mix]] and 21 Herblore experience. A restore mix has 2 doses, restores the listed stats equal to 10 + 30% of the related current level, rounded down, for each skill, and heals 3 [[Hitpoints]].

===Restore potion(4)===

A restore potion(4) is a reward from [[Jekyll and Hyde]] [[random event]]s if a [[harralander]] is given to Dr Jekyll.

When [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], [[Ranged]], or [[Magic]] are temporarily reduced, the amount of levels restored is calculated with: <math>\lfloor SkillLevel \times \frac{3}{10} \rfloor + 10</math> for each of those skills up to the player's current level of that skill.

cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''Prayer potion''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[snape grass]] on a [[ranarr potion (unf)]], requiring 38 [[Herblore]], yielding a Prayer potion(3) and 87.5 Herblore [[experience]]. secondaryExcerpts:
As compared to similar potions (purchasing the 4-dose variant), at level 99 Prayer:
* Prayer potions cost {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Prayer potion(4)}}/4/31|c}} per Prayer point restored
* [[Super restore]] potions cost {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Super restore(4)}}/4/32|c}} per Prayer point restored
* [[Prayer regeneration potions]] cost {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Prayer regeneration potion(4)}}/4/66|c}} per Prayer point restored
* [[Moonlight moth mix (2)]] costs {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Moonlight moth mix (2)}}/2/22|c}} per Prayer point restored
Prayer potions are always in high demand due to use of Prayers during combat or skilling activities and a need to restore points without travelling to an [[altar]].

A Prayer mix has 2 doses, restores Prayer by the same amounts, and heals 6 [[Hitpoints]], with the disadvantage being it now incurs an attack delay.

cases.rationale: Own Strength boost supports finished potion with continuing combat use; super-combat/divine/mix recipes are secondary. Four own doses retain.

cases.title: Zamorak brew
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''Zamorak brew''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[jangerberries]] on a [[torstol potion (unf)]], requiring 78 [[Herblore]], yielding a Zamorak brew(3) and 175 Herblore [[experience]]. A dose of Zamorak brew provides a [[temporary skill boost]] to [[Attack]] equal to 2 + 20% of the player's base Attack level, rounded down, and [[Strength]] equal to 2 + 12% of the player's base Strength level, rounded down. It temporarily lowers [[Defence]] equal to 2 + 10% of the player's current Defence level, rounded down, and current [[Hitpoints]] by 12%, rounded down, though it will not lower a player's [[Hitpoints]] below the minimum of 1. Additionally, 10% of the player's current [[Prayer]] level is restored as Prayer points. When used in conjunction with a [[Saradomin brew]], Attack and Defence will be boosted, Prayer and Health will be restored (possibly boosted by the brew), Ranged and Magic will be lowered.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: A '''Zamorak brew''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[jangerberries]] on a [[torstol potion (unf)]], requiring 78 [[Herblore]], yielding a Zamorak brew(3) and 175 Herblore [[experience]]. A dose of Zamorak brew provides a [[temporary skill boost]] to [[Attack]] equal to 2 + 20% of the player's base Attack level, rounded down, and [[Strength]] equal to 2 + 12% of the player's base Strength level, rounded down. It temporarily lowers [[Defence]] equal to 2 + 10% of the player's current Defence level, rounded down, and current [[Hitpoints]] by 12%, rounded down, though it will not lower a player's [[Hitpoints]] below the minimum of 1. Additionally, 10% of the player's current [[Prayer]] level is restored as Prayer points. When used in conjunction with a [[Saradomin brew]], Attack and Defence will be boosted, Prayer and Health will be restored (possibly boosted by the brew), Ranged and Magic will be lowered.
secondaryExcerpts: Additionally, Zamorak brews are a potion used sometimes on [[Ironman Mode]] accounts, in situations like training the [[Slayer]] skill while using protection prayers, as the potion cannot kill the player and restores prayer. This saves the player valuable resources such as super restore and prayer potions in exchange for excess [[Torstol|torstols]] gathered through farm runs that may not be needed for super combat potions.

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]] is completed, [[caviar]] can be added to a Zamorak brew(2) to produce a [[Zamorak mix]]. This requires 85 Herblore and provides 58 Herblore experience. A Zamorak mix has 2 doses, each of which heals 6 [[Hitpoints]] in addition to the usual Zamorak brew behaviour.

Another use for Zamorak brews is to use it as a source of healing while pickpocketing. As it is a cheaper alternative to prayer potions, it can be used to refill your prayer points after activating [[Redemption]].
Hitpoints drain is calculated with: <math>\lfloor HitpointsLevel \times \frac{12}{100} \rfloor</math>

[[Restore potion]]s are frequently used with Zamorak brews to raise lowered Defence. A [[super strength potion]] will always boost Strength level higher than a Zamorak brew; however, the Zamorak brew's Attack boost is slightly better than a [[super attack potion]]. At levels 85, 86, 90-93, and 95-99, the Zamorak brew will give a boost of 2 levels more than a Super attack potion. You can also use a super strength potion or a [[dragon battleaxe]] [[special attack]] before you sip a dose to increase your Strength level to the max.
Prayer restore is calculated with: <math>\lfloor PrayerLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor</math>
Zamorak brews '''cannot''' be used with the [[Lunar spell]] [[Boost Potion Share]].

==Usage==
A common use for Zamorak brews is when killing [[Corporeal Beast]], where a dose can be used before fighting and the lowered stats restored with an [[ornate rejuvenation pool]]. The brews have a slightly bigger boost to Attack than [[super combat potion]]s and are cheaper, making them a decent alternative. However, they are rare for general use due to the drawbacks.

Hitpoints drain is calculated with: <math>\lfloor HitpointsLevel \times \frac{12}{100} \rfloor</math>

[[Restore potion]]s are frequently used with Zamorak brews to raise lowered Defence. A [[super strength potion]] will always boost Strength level higher than a Zamorak brew; however, the Zamorak brew's Attack boost is slightly better than a [[super attack potion]]. At levels 85, 86, 90-93, and 95-99, the Zamorak brew will give a boost of 2 levels more than a Super attack potion. You can also use a super strength potion or a [[dragon battleaxe]] [[special attack]] before you sip a dose to increase your Strength level to the max.
Prayer restore is calculated with: <math>\lfloor PrayerLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor</math>
Zamorak brews '''cannot''' be used with the [[Lunar spell]] [[Boost Potion Share]].

==Usage==
A common use for Zamorak brews is when killing [[Corporeal Beast]], where a dose can be used before fighting and the lowered stats restored with an [[ornate rejuvenation pool]]. The brews have a slightly bigger boost to Attack than [[super combat potion]]s and are cheaper, making them a decent alternative. However, they are rare for general use due to the drawbacks.
cases.rationale: Own Attack/Strength boosts, Defence/HP drains and Prayer restoration support finished potion; HP cannot be reduced below one. Ironman combat/Redemption uses are continuing effects; mix recipe is secondary. Four doses retain.

relatedExactSourceStorageOrInventoryRest: Additionally, Zamorak brews are a potion used sometimes on [[Ironman Mode]] accounts, in situations like training the [[Slayer]] skill while using protection prayers, as the potion cannot kill the player and restores prayer. This saves the player valuable resources such as super restore and prayer potions in exchange for excess [[Torstol|torstols]] gathered through farm runs that may not be needed for super combat potions.

cases.title: Zamorak brew
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''Zamorak brew''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[jangerberries]] on a [[torstol potion (unf)]], requiring 78 [[Herblore]], yielding a Zamorak brew(3) and 175 Herblore [[experience]]. A dose of Zamorak brew provides a [[temporary skill boost]] to [[Attack]] equal to 2 + 20% of the player's base Attack level, rounded down, and [[Strength]] equal to 2 + 12% of the player's base Strength level, rounded down. It temporarily lowers [[Defence]] equal to 2 + 10% of the player's current Defence level, rounded down, and current [[Hitpoints]] by 12%, rounded down, though it will not lower a player's [[Hitpoints]] below the minimum of 1. Additionally, 10% of the player's current [[Prayer]] level is restored as Prayer points. When used in conjunction with a [[Saradomin brew]], Attack and Defence will be boosted, Prayer and Health will be restored (possibly boosted by the brew), Ranged and Magic will be lowered.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: A '''Zamorak brew''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[jangerberries]] on a [[torstol potion (unf)]], requiring 78 [[Herblore]], yielding a Zamorak brew(3) and 175 Herblore [[experience]]. A dose of Zamorak brew provides a [[temporary skill boost]] to [[Attack]] equal to 2 + 20% of the player's base Attack level, rounded down, and [[Strength]] equal to 2 + 12% of the player's base Strength level, rounded down. It temporarily lowers [[Defence]] equal to 2 + 10% of the player's current Defence level, rounded down, and current [[Hitpoints]] by 12%, rounded down, though it will not lower a player's [[Hitpoints]] below the minimum of 1. Additionally, 10% of the player's current [[Prayer]] level is restored as Prayer points. When used in conjunction with a [[Saradomin brew]], Attack and Defence will be boosted, Prayer and Health will be restored (possibly boosted by the brew), Ranged and Magic will be lowered.
secondaryExcerpts: Additionally, Zamorak brews are a potion used sometimes on [[Ironman Mode]] accounts, in situations like training the [[Slayer]] skill while using protection prayers, as the potion cannot kill the player and restores prayer. This saves the player valuable resources such as super restore and prayer potions in exchange for excess [[Torstol|torstols]] gathered through farm runs that may not be needed for super combat potions.

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]] is completed, [[caviar]] can be added to a Zamorak brew(2) to produce a [[Zamorak mix]]. This requires 85 Herblore and provides 58 Herblore experience. A Zamorak mix has 2 doses, each of which heals 6 [[Hitpoints]] in addition to the usual Zamorak brew behaviour.

Another use for Zamorak brews is to use it as a source of healing while pickpocketing. As it is a cheaper alternative to prayer potions, it can be used to refill your prayer points after activating [[Redemption]].
Hitpoints drain is calculated with: <math>\lfloor HitpointsLevel \times \frac{12}{100} \rfloor</math>

[[Restore potion]]s are frequently used with Zamorak brews to raise lowered Defence. A [[super strength potion]] will always boost Strength level higher than a Zamorak brew; however, the Zamorak brew's Attack boost is slightly better than a [[super attack potion]]. At levels 85, 86, 90-93, and 95-99, the Zamorak brew will give a boost of 2 levels more than a Super attack potion. You can also use a super strength potion or a [[dragon battleaxe]] [[special attack]] before you sip a dose to increase your Strength level to the max.
Prayer restore is calculated with: <math>\lfloor PrayerLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor</math>
Zamorak brews '''cannot''' be used with the [[Lunar spell]] [[Boost Potion Share]].

==Usage==
A common use for Zamorak brews is when killing [[Corporeal Beast]], where a dose can be used before fighting and the lowered stats restored with an [[ornate rejuvenation pool]]. The brews have a slightly bigger boost to Attack than [[super combat potion]]s and are cheaper, making them a decent alternative. However, they are rare for general use due to the drawbacks.

cases.title: Antifire potion
cases.semanticExcerpt: An '''antifire potion''' provides slight immunity to a [[Dragonfire|dragon's breath]]. When used in conjunction with an [[anti-dragon shield]] or [[dragonfire shield]], a single dose will provide complete immunity against [[dragonfire]] for 6 minutes. It can be made by a player with 69 [[Herblore]] by mixing clean [[lantadyme]] and then [[dragon scale dust]] in a [[vial of water]], which grants 157.5 Herblore experience. It may only be used after starting [[Dragon Slayer I]]. Additionally, it can be upgraded to either an [[extended antifire|extended]] or [[super antifire]] by adding [[lava scale shard]]s with 84 Herblore or [[crushed superior dragon bones]] with 92 Herblore, respectively.

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]] is completed, [[caviar]] can be added to an antifire potion(2) to produce an [[antifire mix]]. This requires 75 Herblore and provides 53 Herblore experience. An antifire mix has 2 doses, each of which heals 6 [[Hitpoints]] in addition to the usual antifire immunity.

==Trivia==
* Trying to drink the potion before starting [[Dragon Slayer I]] gives the message {{mes|You must have started the Dragon Slayer I quest to drink this potion.}}

Players will get a warning in their chatbox when the potion is about to wear off after approximately 5 minutes, 45 seconds: "''{{Colour|#7f007f|Your antifire potion is about to expire.}}''" Then they will get another message when it has worn off, approximately 6 minutes in total: "''{{Colour|#7f007f|Your antifire potion has expired.}}''" This allows you to keep track of how long you have until you have to drink again.

'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' Players should remember that an antifire potion alone will '''not''' fully protect them from dragonfire (players will get a message in their text box stating that they have been horribly burnt by the fire). The potion's protection is so slight that, when used alone, even a single dragon can cause extensive damage to the player from its breath. Only when the potion is combined with the anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield will players be completely immune to dragonfire.

[[Protect from Magic]], in conjunction with an antifire or extended antifire, may be used in place of an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield to grant complete immunity to close-range dragonfire attacks, such as those from [[chromatic dragons]]. Using Protect from Magic does not provide any dragonfire protection from the long-range dragonfire attacks of [[metal dragons]], such as [[mithril dragon|mithril]] or [[rune dragon]]s, and an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield must be used for complete immunity.
cases.rationale: Own dragonfire protection supports finished active potion. Full protection is conditional on other protection and not a blanket immunity claim. Dragon Slayer prerequisite, upgrade recipes, and mix production are disclosed; current exact doses retained.

It can be made by a player with 69 [[Herblore]] by mixing clean [[lantadyme]] and then [[dragon scale dust]] in a [[vial of water]], which grants 157.5 Herblore experience. It may only be used after starting [[Dragon Slayer I]]. Additionally, it can be upgraded to either an [[extended antifire|extended]] or [[super antifire]] by adding [[lava scale shard]]s with 84 Herblore or [[crushed superior dragon bones]] with 92 Herblore, respectively.

cases.title: Super energy
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''super energy''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by mixing [[avantoe]] with [[Mort myre fungus|mort myre fungi]] in a [[vial of water]], giving 117.5 [[Herblore]] [[experience]]. It requires level 52 Herblore.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: Super energy potions recover 20% of [[Energy|run energy]] per dose.
secondaryExcerpts:
===Super energy(3)===
{{Drop sources|Super energy(3)}}

==Price per dose==
{{Price per dose|Super energy}}
Super energy potions recover 20% of [[Energy|run energy]] per dose.

==Trivia==
*Unlike most "super" potions, this potion's secondary ingredient is different from its "normal" counterpart. [[Energy potions]] use [[chocolate dust]], whereas this potion uses [[Mort myre fungus|mort myre fungi]].

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]] is completed, [[caviar]] can be added to a super energy(2) to produce a [[super energy mix]]. This requires 56 Herblore and provides 39 Herblore experience. A super energy mix has 2 doses, each of which heals 6 [[Hitpoints]] in addition to the normal super energy recovery.

===Super energy(4)===
{{Drop sources|Super energy(4)}}

Super energy potions can be a budget friendly option for players wishing to save costs on supplies. Super energy potions give the same 20% run energy restore as [[Stamina potion|Stamina potions]] just without the 70% reduction in run energy depletion for 2 minutes. Stamina potions can run as much as 3x the cost of super energy potions so players may wish to use super energies when reduction in run energy depletion isn't needed, and only additional run energy is needed for their current task. Additionally, players can make unused Super energy potions into stamina potions as they progress their accounts as mentioned above.

==Creation==
{{Recipe
|skill1 = Herblore
|skill1lvl = 52
|skill1boostable = Yes
|skill1exp = 117.5
|members = Yes
|ticks = 2
|mat1 = Avantoe potion (unf)
|mat2 = Mort myre fungus
|output1 = Super energy(3)
}}
==Products==
{{Uses material list|Super energy(1)|Super energy(2)|Super energy(3)|Super energy(4)}}
At 77 Herblore they can be used to make [[stamina potion]]s using [[amylase crystal]]s.
cases.rationale: Own twenty-percent run-energy restoration supports finished potion; no stamina-style drain reduction is inferred. Stamina/mix recipes are secondary and four dose routes retain.

cases.title: Super restore
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''super restore''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] that restores all player [[stats]] that have been lowered, including [[Prayer]], but not [[Hitpoints]]. Players with level 63 [[Herblore]] can make a super restore potion by using a [[red spiders' eggs]] on a [[snapdragon potion (unf)]], giving 142.5 [[experience]]. Super restores can further be made into [[Sanfew serum]]s by adding (in order) [[unicorn horn dust]], [[snake weed]], and [[nail beast nails]] into a super restore potion.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: A '''super restore''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] that restores all player [[stats]] that have been lowered, including [[Prayer]], but not [[Hitpoints]]. Players with level 63 [[Herblore]] can make a super restore potion by using a [[red spiders' eggs]] on a [[snapdragon potion (unf)]], giving 142.5 [[experience]]. {{Store locations list|Super restore(4)}}

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]] is completed, [[caviar]] can be added to a super restore(2) to produce a [[super restore mix]]. This requires 67 Herblore and provides 48 Herblore experience. A super restore mix has 2 doses, each of which heals 6 [[Hitpoints]] in addition to the super restore recovery.

===Super restore(3)===
{{Drop sources|Super restore(3)}}

As compared to similar potions (purchasing the 4-dose variant), at level 99 Prayer:
* Super restore potions cost {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Super restore(4)}}/4/32|c}} per Prayer point restored
* [[Prayer potions]] cost {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Prayer potion(4)}}/4/31|c}} per Prayer point restored
* [[Prayer regeneration potions]] cost {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Prayer regeneration potion(4)}}/4/66|c}} per Prayer point restored

==Creation==
{{Recipe
|skill1 = Herblore
|skill1lvl = 63
|skill1boostable = Yes
|skill1exp = 142.5
|members = Yes
|ticks = 2
|mat1 = Snapdragon potion (unf)
|mat2 = Red spiders' eggs
|output1 = Super restore(3)
}}

The restore value obtained per dose is 8 + 25% of the player's base level (rounded down) in each of the affected [[skills]]. For example, a player with 84 [[Thieving]] and 63 [[Smithing]] would restore both 29 points of Thieving and 23 points of Smithing for each dose consumed. The maximum amount of points that can be restored with this potion is 32 at level 96. This means that a super restore potion will restore 1 more Prayer point per dose than a [[prayer potion]].

===Super restore(4)===
{{Drop sources|Super restore(4)}}

==Products==
{{Uses material list|Super restore(1)|Super restore(2)|Super restore(3)|Super restore(4)}}

===Super restore(2)===
{{Drop sources|Super restore(2)}}
Two 3-dose super restores can be obtained by starting the [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]] [[quest]].

If a [[Prayer cape]] or [[ring of the gods (i)]] is equipped, or a [[holy wrench]] is in the player's inventory, the ''prayer'' restore increases to 8 + 27% of the player's current Prayer level, rounded down. This does not affect the rate of restoration of stats other than Prayer.
cases.rationale: Own lowered-stat restoration including Prayer and excluding Hitpoints supports potion. Sanfew/mix recipes and quest acquisition are secondary. Prayer accessory enhancement does not affect other restored stats.

It is also possible to obtain a 4-dose agility potion from the [[Possessed Priest]] at the end of [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]]. cases.rationale: Own Agility +3 supports finished active potion across four exact states; current dose subtypes retained. Two-dose downstream mix recipe and four-dose Tai Bwo Wannai Trio requirement are real competing uses, but do not replace active potion primary.

cases.title: Relicym's balm
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Relicym's balm''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] that can cure [[disease]]. To do so, multiple doses of relicym's balm must be drunk, with each dose weakening the strength of the disease. However, the potion does not offer any temporary immunity, unlike [[Sanfew serum]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: '''Relicym's balm''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] that can cure [[disease]]. To do so, multiple doses of relicym's balm must be drunk, with each dose weakening the strength of the disease. However, the potion does not offer any temporary immunity, unlike [[Sanfew serum]].
secondaryExcerpts: The potion is made by mixing [[rogue's purse]] and [[snake weed]] in a [[vial of water]], giving 40 [[Herblore]] experience. It requires level 8 Herblore and completion of the [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]] quest to the point where [[Sithik Ints]] tells the player how to cure the [[Zogre]] disease.

Relicym's balm is the preferred weapon to use against yellow [[broodoo victim]]s during the [[Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup]] [[minigame]], as it can deal over 25 damage to them. Relicym's balm can also be used as a cheaper alternative to [[Sanfew serum]]s to reduce the damage caused by [[Parasite|parasites]] when fighting [[The Nightmare]].

Players may purchase 3 dose potions from [[Uglug Nar]] for 200 [[coins]] once they've learned how to make the potion. To open Uglug Nar's store, simply give him a Relicym's balm potion of any dosage, for which he will pay 100 (1 dose), 300 (2 doses), 650 (3 doses) or 1000 (4 doses) gold. Note that Uglug will buy these potions from players for 120 gold as well if he has none in stock, but it must be a 3 dose potion for him to make an offer.

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]], [[roe]] or [[caviar]] can be added to a 2 dose relicym's balm, requiring 9 Herblore, yielding a [[Relicym's mix]] and 14 Herblore experience.

exactVariantFacts.value: 4 doses of Relicym's balm, which helps cure disease.

cases.rationale: Own disease cure without immunity supports finished potion. Yellow broodoo and Nightmare parasite interactions are positive competing combat uses; shop unlocking does not make it quest-only.

Players may purchase 3 dose potions from [[Uglug Nar]] for 200 [[coins]] once they've learned how to make the potion. To open Uglug Nar's store, simply give him a Relicym's balm potion of any dosage, for which he will pay 100 (1 dose), 300 (2 doses), 650 (3 doses) or 1000 (4 doses) gold. Note that Uglug will buy these potions from players for 120 gold as well if he has none in stock, but it must be a 3 dose potion for him to make an offer.

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]], [[roe]] or [[caviar]] can be added to a 2 dose relicym's balm, requiring 9 Herblore, yielding a [[Relicym's mix]] and 14 Herblore experience.

cases.title: Antidote+
cases.semanticExcerpt: The '''antidote+''' is a potion made by mixing a [[toadflax]] in a [[vial]] of [[coconut milk]], making an [[antidote+ (unf)]], and then adding a [[yew root]]. This requires 68 [[Herblore]] and gives 155 [[Herblore]] experience. Four doses are created instead of the usual three.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: Antidote+ cures [[poison]], and provides immunity to poison for 9 minutes, 3 minutes longer than that of [[superantipoison]]s. However, depending on your budget, it is often recommended to use an [[Antidote++]] as it lasts an additional 3 minutes for a total of 12 minutes. Drinking two doses of antidote+ will cure [[venom]]. The first dose will reduce the venom to poison and the second will remove the poison.

cases.title: Magic essence
cases.semanticExcerpt: The '''magic essence''' is a potion that plays a major part in the quest [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]]. The potion requires level 57 [[Herblore]] to create, and will give 130 [[experience]] per potion made. The potion is made by adding a [[starflower]] to a [[vial of water]], and then adding [[gorak claw powder]], made by using a [[pestle and mortar]] on a set of [[gorak claws]]. Drinking a dose of magic essence temporarily raises the player's [[Magic]] level by 3.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: The '''magic essence''' is a potion that plays a major part in the quest [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]]. The potion requires level 57 [[Herblore]] to create, and will give 130 [[experience]] per potion made. The potion is made by adding a [[starflower]] to a [[vial of water]], and then adding [[gorak claw powder]], made by using a [[pestle and mortar]] on a set of [[gorak claws]]. Drinking a dose of magic essence temporarily raises the player's [[Magic]] level by 3.
secondaryExcerpts:
=== Magic essence mix ===
{{Main|Magic essence mix}}
Players who have completed the [[Barbarian Training]] [[miniquest]] can add [[caviar]] into a 2-dose magic essence to create a [[magic essence mix]]. The mix provides the same boost, but also heals six [[Hitpoints]]. The Barbarian version of the potion is [[tradeable]], but '''will not''' cure the [[Fairy Queen|Queen]].
==Creation==
{{Recipe
|skill1 = Herblore
|skill1lvl = 57
|skill1boostable = Yes
|skill1exp = 130
|members = Yes
|ticks = 2
|mat1 = Magic essence (unf)
|mat1cost = No
|mat2 = Gorak claw powder
|mat2cost = No
|output1 = Magic essence(3)
|output1cost = No
}}
==Products==
{{Uses material list|Magic essence(1)|Magic essence(2)|Magic essence(3)|Magic essence(4)}}

=== Ingredients ===
Both the primary and secondary ingredients for the potion require partial completion of Fairytale II to obtain. Gorak claws are frequently dropped from [[gorak]]s, which can be found either in a separate dimension using [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|DIR}}, or in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. [[Starflower]]s are found on another dimension, the [[Cosmic Plane]], which can be reached via Fairy Ring code {{fairycode|CKP}}. The flowers take about 2–5 minutes to start growing after the player arrives on the plane and require level 49 [[Farming]] to be picked.
cases.rationale: Own Magic +3 is a continuing finished-potion effect. Fairytale II Queen cure is a positive competing quest use; recipe/access context does not override the finished potion route. Mix cannot perform that cure.

relatedExactSourceStorageOrInventoryRest: As Sanfew serums' higher price often makes [[super restore]]s and [[prayer potion]]s more cost efficient for restoring prayer, Sanfew serums are notably useful in situations where prayer restoration as well as poison protection are needed and inventory space is limited, such as [[Dagannoth Kings]], as it fulfills the two requirements in one inventory space. Similarly, Sanfew serums are effective for fighting [[The Nightmare]] as they offer the same utility against [[parasite]]s as Relicym's balm while also offering prayer restoration.

Sanfew serums can also be used on [[nail beast]]s, which can deal 20-40 damage per dose and grants [[melee]] [[experience]]. This requires the player to have no weapons equipped; if they do, it will automatically be unequipped if there is space in their [[inventory]].

Be aware that this mix '''does not''' directly heal [[Hitpoints]]; instead, this mix deals <math display="inline">\left\lfloor (\mathit{HP}-1)/8 \right\rfloor</math> damage (based on current hitpoints) then later in the same [[game tick]] heals 6 hitpoints.

cases.title: Super magic potion
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''super magic potion''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] only usable in the [[Nightmare Zone]], costing 250 points per dose. It boosts one's [[Magic]] stat by 15% + 5. Because of this, it makes spells a great deal more accurate while providing lower levels the ability to use spells far above their Magic level. For example, one with 78 Magic could sip this potion to be able to cast [[Ice Barrage]]. At 99 Magic, this potion will boost one's Magic level to 118. You cannot use this to enchant jewellery.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: A '''super magic potion''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] only usable in the [[Nightmare Zone]], costing 250 points per dose. It boosts one's [[Magic]] stat by 15% + 5. Because of this, it makes spells a great deal more accurate while providing lower levels the ability to use spells far above their Magic level. For example, one with 78 Magic could sip this potion to be able to cast [[Ice Barrage]]. At 99 Magic, this potion will boost one's Magic level to 118. You cannot use this to enchant jewellery.
secondaryExcerpts:
==Magic boost by level==
Magic boost is calculated with: <math>\lfloor MagicLevel \times \frac{15}{100} \rfloor + 5</math>
Compared to the [[Saturated heart]], it grants a stronger Magic boost, but it decays over time unlike the boost from the saturated heart.
cases.rationale: Own Magic boost and explicit only-in-Nightmare-Zone use support activity potion; explicit no jewellery enchanting prevents that alternate inference. Cost/acquisition is secondary and banking still needs proof.

cases.title: Overload (Nightmare Zone)
cases.semanticExcerpt: An '''overload''' is a potion purchased from [[Dom Onion's Reward Shop]] for 1,500 [[Nightmare Zone]] points per dose. Overloads cannot be used outside the [[Nightmare Zone]]. Drinking an overload raises a player's [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], [[Ranged]], and [[Magic]] levels by 5-19 (5 + 15% of the player's level, rounded down) for five minutes, while causing them to take 50 [[Hitpoints|hitpoints]] worth of damage over the course of several seconds. This damage is not absorbed if the player has used an [[Absorption]] potion.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: An '''overload''' is a potion purchased from [[Dom Onion's Reward Shop]] for 1,500 [[Nightmare Zone]] points per dose. Overloads cannot be used outside the [[Nightmare Zone]]. Drinking an overload raises a player's [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], [[Ranged]], and [[Magic]] levels by 5-19 (5 + 15% of the player's level, rounded down) for five minutes, while causing them to take 50 [[Hitpoints|hitpoints]] worth of damage over the course of several seconds. This damage is not absorbed if the player has used an [[Absorption]] potion.
secondaryExcerpts: Level boosts from an overload are reapplied every 15 seconds until the 5 minute duration ends, at which point the player is healed for 50 [[Hitpoints]] and the boosts wear off. Boosts from overloads do progressively decay over time, but given the 15 second reapplications, they effectively remain near or at full effect until the potion wears off.
[[File:Overload_usage.gif|frame|left|A player drinking a dose of overload.]]

==Stat boosts by level==
Boosts to most combat skills is calculated with: <math>\lfloor \text{Level} \times \frac{15}{100} \rfloor + 5</math>

It is not possible to use an overload if the player currently has less than 51 [[Hitpoints]]. However, if a player drinks an overload and lowers their [[Hitpoints]]  (such as by using a [[dwarven rock cake]] or [[locator orb]]) before the overload has finished causing damage, the resulting damage will kill them.
cases.rationale: Explicit only-in-Nightmare-Zone use and own combat boost/fifty-damage mechanic support activity potion. Fifty-one HP prerequisite does not prove inability to bank.

cases.title: Absorption
cases.semanticExcerpt:
[[File:Absorption counter.png|thumb|left|The counter denoting how much damage the player will absorb.]]
[[File:Absorption damage.png|thumb|A player absorbs damage using the absorption potion.]]
'''Absorption''' is a potion from the [[Nightmare Zone]] minigame, costing 1,000 reward points per dose. It can only be used while in the Nightmare Zone. Absorption '''does not carry over''' between rounds.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Absorption counter.png|thumb|left|The counter denoting how much damage the player will absorb.]]
[[File:Absorption damage.png|thumb|A player absorbs damage using the absorption potion.]]
'''Absorption''' is a potion from the [[Nightmare Zone]] minigame, costing 1,000 reward points per dose. It can only be used while in the Nightmare Zone. Absorption '''does not carry over''' between rounds.
secondaryExcerpts: Drinking the potion causes the next 50 damage inflicted on the player to be absorbed, preventing the player from taking damage. Each dose will absorb 50 damage, which stacks with previous unused Absorption damage up to 1,000 damage. It will not absorb damage the player inflicts on themselves, such as from [[Overload (Nightmare Zone)|overload]] potions, [[poison karambwan]]s, or [[dwarven rock cake]]s, nor will it absorb poison damage from an enemy.

A good way to boost the effectiveness of the absorption potion is to use the [[dwarven rock cake]] or [[locator orb]] to lower your hitpoints, and flick the [[Rapid Heal]] prayer to stop your hitpoints from being restored. This will leave you with only 1 hitpoint, so enemies will only be able to inflict a maximum of 1 damage on you at a time, so a maximum of only 1 damage will be drained from Absorption per enemy hit.
cases.rationale: Own 50-damage-per-dose absorption effect and explicit only-in-Nightmare-Zone use justify activity-potion; no carry-over between rounds. Each of four own IDs is a separate dose state. Reward purchase is acquisition, not the reason for activity grouping.

cases.title: Extended antifire
cases.semanticExcerpt: An '''extended antifire''' potion is a potion that provides slight immunity to a [[Dragonfire|dragon's breath]]. When used in conjunction with an [[anti-dragon shield]] or [[dragonfire shield]], it will provide complete immunity against [[dragonfire]] for 12 minutes (1200 game ticks) per dose (48 minutes per 4-dose potion). Antifire potions are especially useful against [[metal dragons]] and the [[King Black Dragon]], though only when combined with other said forms of protection.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: An '''extended antifire''' potion is a potion that provides slight immunity to a [[Dragonfire|dragon's breath]]. When used in conjunction with an [[anti-dragon shield]] or [[dragonfire shield]], it will provide complete immunity against [[dragonfire]] for 12 minutes (1200 game ticks) per dose (48 minutes per 4-dose potion). Antifire potions are especially useful against [[metal dragons]] and the [[King Black Dragon]], though only when combined with other said forms of protection.
secondaryExcerpts: Players will get a warning in their chatbox when the potion is about to wear off: "''{{Colour|#7f007f|Your antifire potion is about to expire.}}''" Then they will get another message when it has worn off, approximately 15 seconds after the initial warning: "''{{Colour|#7f007f|Your antifire potion has expired.}}''" This allows you to keep track of how long you have until you have to drink again.

'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' Players should remember that an antifire potion alone will '''not''' fully protect them from dragonfire (players will get a message in their text box stating that they have been horribly burnt by the fire). The potion's protection is so slight that, when used alone, even a single dragon can cause extensive damage to the player from its breath. Only when the potion is combined with the anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield will players be completely immune to dragonfire.

[[Protect from Magic]], in conjunction with an antifire or extended antifire, may be used in place of an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield to grant complete immunity to close-range dragonfire attacks, such as those from [[chromatic dragons]]. Using Protect from Magic does not provide any dragonfire protection from the long-range dragonfire attacks of [[metal dragons]], such as [[mithril dragon|mithril]] or [[rune dragon]]s, and an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield must be used for complete immunity.
It may only be used after starting [[Dragon Slayer I]].

It can be made by a player with 84 [[Herblore]] by mixing a regular [[antifire]] and [[lava scale shard]]s, which grants 110 experience if they put in four shards into an antifire (4). 27.5 Herblore experience is granted per shard added. One dose is created per shard, so four shards will be needed to create a four-dosed extended antifire. Players with at least 91 Herblore can mix [[caviar]] into a 2-dose [[extended antifire mix]].
cases.rationale: Own dragonfire protection is active and conditional on other defence for full coverage. Dragon Slayer I drinking prerequisite does not make quest/activity-only primary; upgrading to super or mixing are secondary. All own four doses retained.

==Utility==

Stamina potions are extremely useful in activities that require a lot of running. With a low enough [[weight]], the reduced energy depletion will result in minimal loss of energy even with non-stop running, especially combined with the 20% restoration when taking another dose.

The relevance of stamina potions diminished with the 2025 [[Update:Run Energy Changes|Run Energy Changes]] update, as run energy drain was decreased across the board. While Dr Jekyll normally despawns if a player runs into a bank, several locations (typically those without a booth) are exempt from this. Examples include the banks on [[Lunar Isle]], in the [[Myths' Guild]], and at the [[Theatre of Blood]]. Players lucky enough to be near those locations when he spawns can use this to grab a torstol from the bank, if they have one. An unprepared player may minigame teleport to [[Last Man Standing]] and speak to the [[Banker (Ferox Enclave)|Banker]] to withdraw a banked herb with a few seconds to spare.

Due to the rarity of the event, players often save up ten staminas to build the [[revitalisation pool]] in their [[player-owned house]], which requires 70 [[Construction]]. Outside of obtaining it through monster drops, players without the [[Farming]] level to grow torstol can obtain it from the [[Reward Cart|Wintertodt Reward Cart]], the [[Dark Chest|dark chest]] on the [[Isle of Souls]], or the [[Sinister chest]] in the [[Yanille Agility Dungeon]]. Players lacking the required level to clean Torstol can have [[Zahur]] clean their grimy herbs; alternatively, clean Torstol can also be obtained from [[Zulrah]] or [[Nature impling]]s.

cases.title: Anti-venom
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Anti-venom''' is a potion that instantly cures [[venom]] and [[poison]]. It provides immunity to poison for 12 minutes and immunity to venom for 36-54 seconds.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: '''Anti-venom''' is a potion that instantly cures [[venom]] and [[poison]]. It provides immunity to poison for 12 minutes and immunity to venom for 36-54 seconds.
secondaryExcerpts: Anti-venom is used to create [[anti-venom+]], which cures poison and venom and provides immunity to venom for three minutes. This can be done by adding a clean [[torstol]] into it, requiring 94 Herblore and granting 125 Herblore experience.

==Treasure Trails==
*{{SherlockChallenge|Mixing an anti-venom potion|master}}

Players can make this potion at 87 [[Herblore]] by using [[Zulrah's scales]] on an [[Antidote++]]. Five scales are needed per dose of antidote++, so 20 scales will be needed to create a four-dose Anti-venom. This grants 30 Herblore [[experience]] per dose.
cases.rationale: Own poison/venom cure and timed immunity support active potion. Upgrading with torstol is a real Herblore use; Sherlock and diary mixing requirements concern production. Retain all own dose states and existing derived partial tabs.

A Xeric's aid restores Hitpoints by 12% + 2 and Defence by 18% + 2, both rounded down.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1478324637880750083|date=4 January 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106509|archivedate=6 January 2021|quote=HP: TIER plus ((5 x TIER) + 2) percent. Defence: TIER plus ((4 x TIER) + 10) percent.}} It can heal above the player's maximum Hitpoints level. It temporarily lowers Strength, Attack, Magic and Ranged by 9% + 2.
This potion is the standard variant of Xeric's aid, and cannot be taken out of the [[Chambers of Xeric]].

cases.semanticExcerpt: An '''overload (-)''' is a potion that boosts all the player's combat stats by 4 + 10%, while damaging them for 50 [[hitpoints]]. This boost is repeated every 15 seconds for five minutes until the effects wear off, and the player is then healed 50 hitpoints.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: An '''overload (-)''' is a potion that boosts all the player's combat stats by 4 + 10%, while damaging them for 50 [[hitpoints]]. This boost is repeated every 15 seconds for five minutes until the effects wear off, and the player is then healed 50 hitpoints.
secondaryExcerpts: This potion is the weakest variant of the overload potions, and cannot be taken out of the [[Chambers of Xeric]]. The [[Overload (Chambers of Xeric)|standard variant]] requires the regular secondary potions, and 75 Herblore, whilst the [[Overload (+)|strongest variant]] requires the strongest secondary potions, and 90 Herblore.
It can only be made in the [[Chambers of Xeric]] with 60 to 75 [[Herblore]] by using a [[noxifer]] with any variant of an [[elder potion]], [[twisted potion]], and [[kodai potion]].

cases.title: Super antifire potion
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''super antifire potion''' is a potion made with [[Herblore]] that provides complete immunity to regular [[dragonfire]] for three minutes, as well as partially blocking the stronger dragonfire of [[Galvek]] and [[Vorkath]]. It may only be used after starting [[Dragon Slayer I]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: A '''super antifire potion''' is a potion made with [[Herblore]] that provides complete immunity to regular [[dragonfire]] for three minutes, as well as partially blocking the stronger dragonfire of [[Galvek]] and [[Vorkath]]. It may only be used after starting [[Dragon Slayer I]].
secondaryExcerpts: It will completely block the [[King Black Dragon]]'s standard dragonfire, but not at all his special dragonfires, which can still hit up to 50, so pairing this potion with an [[anti-dragon shield]] is recommended. Given that there is no difference in damage taken between using an anti-dragon shield + (regular) antifire potion versus using an anti-dragon shield + super antifire potion, it's actually better to use a regular antifire potion for this boss, given that its effect lasts twice as long per dose. For more information, read the [[dragonfire]] page.

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]] is completed, [[caviar]] can be added to a super antifire potion(2) to produce a [[super antifire mix]]. This requires 98 Herblore and provides 70 Herblore experience. A super antifire mix has 2 doses, each of which heals 6 [[Hitpoints]] in addition to the usual super antifire behaviour.

To be able to create super antifire potions, the process must first be learned by speaking to [[Primula]], who can be found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} inside the [[Myths' Guild]], which requires completion of [[Dragon Slayer II]] to enter.

==Trivia==
* Super antifire potions were originally offered as a reward from the [[Nightmare Zone]] [[minigame]], where a tradeable ingredient from the reward shop would be used to create them, requiring level 89 Herblore to make (and level 93 to create the barbarian mix version).
** When it was polled in [[Poll:Old School feature poll 10: New Rewards|Old School feature poll 10: New Rewards]], it failed the poll with only 74% support.

It can be made by a player with 92 [[Herblore]] by adding [[crushed superior dragon bones]] to an [[antifire potion]], which grants 130 Herblore experience. With 98 Herblore, the super antifire potion can be upgraded to an [[extended super antifire]] with [[lava scale shard]]s.
cases.rationale: Own regular-dragonfire immunity with partial Galvek/Vorkath protection supports potion. Quest creation/access and extended/mix upgrades are secondary; failed Nightmare Zone proposal is historical, not current restriction.

cases.title: Extended super antifire
cases.semanticExcerpt: An '''extended super antifire''' potion is a potion that provides complete immunity against [[dragonfire]] for exactly six minutes (24 minutes per 4-dose potion). However, the potion's effects '''will not''' work on [[Galvek]]'s attacks, nor will it work on the [[King Black Dragon]]'s poisonous/shocking/freezing dragonbreath. It will also block [[Vorkath]]'s attacks only partially. It may only be used after starting [[Dragon Slayer I]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: An '''extended super antifire''' potion is a potion that provides complete immunity against [[dragonfire]] for exactly six minutes (24 minutes per 4-dose potion). It will also block [[Vorkath]]'s attacks only partially. It may only be used after starting [[Dragon Slayer I]].

Players with 99 Herblore can mix [[caviar]] into a 2-dose extended super antifire to create an [[extended super antifire mix]].

It can be made by a player with 98 [[Herblore]] by mixing a regular super antifire and [[lava scale shard]]s, which grants 40 Herblore experience per shard added, or 160 Herblore experience if they put in four shards into a 4-dosed potion. One dose is created per shard, so four shards will be needed to create a four-dosed extended antifire. Alternatively, it can be made by mixing a 4-dose [[extended antifire]] with [[crushed superior dragon bones]], which grants 180 Herblore experience.

cases.title: Divine super combat potion
cases.semanticExcerpt:
[[File:Drinking divine potion.gif|frame|right|A player drinks a divine potion.]]
The '''divine super combat potion''' is a stat-boosting potion that increases the player's [[Attack]], [[Strength]], and [[Defence]] level by 5 + 15% for 5 minutes. During these 5 minutes, the player's Attack, Strength, and Defence levels will not drain below the maximum boost of the potion. Although natural stat drain is disabled, a player's stats can still be decreased or increased by the use of other spells and potions.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Drinking divine potion.gif|frame|right|A player drinks a divine potion.]]
The '''divine super combat potion''' is a stat-boosting potion that increases the player's [[Attack]], [[Strength]], and [[Defence]] level by 5 + 15% for 5 minutes. During these 5 minutes, the player's Attack, Strength, and Defence levels will not drain below the maximum boost of the potion. Although natural stat drain is disabled, a player's stats can still be decreased or increased by the use of other spells and potions.
secondaryExcerpts: Once the 5 minutes are over, any stats normally boosted by the potion will be reduced back to their base level; [[Preserve]] does not affect the duration of the potion. Drinking this potion will also damage the player by 10 [[Hitpoints]]. Trying to drink the potion with 10 Hitpoints or less will instead prompt the message: {{mes|You need more than 10 hitpoints to survive the power of a divine potion.}}

Boosts to Attack, Strength and Defence can be calculated with: <math>\lfloor SkillLevel \times \frac{15}{100} \rfloor + 5</math>
Players are unable to cast [[Boost Potion Share]] to share the effect across a group of players.
It is created by using [[crystal dust]] on a [[super combat potion]], requiring 97 [[Herblore]].

cases.title: Divine battlemage potion
cases.semanticExcerpt:
[[File:Drinking divine potion.gif|frame|right|A player drinks a divine potion.]]
The '''divine battlemage potion''' is a stat-boosting potion that increases the player's [[Magic]] level by 4, and the player's [[Defence]] level by 5 + 15% of the player's Defence level for 5 minutes. During these 5 minutes, the player's Magic and Defence levels will not drain below the maximum boost of the potion. Although natural stat drain is disabled, a player's stats can still be decreased or increased by the use of other spells and potions.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Drinking divine potion.gif|frame|right|A player drinks a divine potion.]]
The '''divine battlemage potion''' is a stat-boosting potion that increases the player's [[Magic]] level by 4, and the player's [[Defence]] level by 5 + 15% of the player's Defence level for 5 minutes. During these 5 minutes, the player's Magic and Defence levels will not drain below the maximum boost of the potion. Although natural stat drain is disabled, a player's stats can still be decreased or increased by the use of other spells and potions.
secondaryExcerpts:
Mixing divine battlemage potions yields 0.5 Herblore experience per dose.
==Defence boost by level==
Defence boost is calculated with: <math>\lfloor DefenceLevel \times \frac{15}{100} \rfloor + 5</math>

Once the 5 minutes are over, any stats normally boosted by the potion will be reduced back to their base level; [[Preserve]] does not affect the duration of the potion. Drinking this potion will also damage the player by 10 [[Hitpoints]]. Trying to drink the potion with less than 11 Hitpoints will instead prompt the message: {{mes|You need more than 10 hitpoints to survive the power of a divine potion.}}
Players are unable to cast [[Boost Potion Share]] to share the effect across a group of players.
It is created by using [[crystal dust]] on a [[battlemage potion]], requiring 86 [[Herblore]].
cases.rationale: Own Magic/Defence boosts last 5 minutes with stat retention, expiry reset, HP cost and survival threshold. Retain active potion and exact dose subtype; crystal-dust creation is secondary and potion-share inability is not an activity restriction.

Drinking this potion will also damage the player by 10 [[Hitpoints]]. Trying to drink the potion with less than 11 Hitpoints will instead prompt the message: {{mes|You need more than 10 hitpoints to survive the power of a divine potion.}}
Players are unable to cast [[Boost Potion Share]] to share the effect across a group of players.

Mixing divine bastion potions yields 0.5 Herblore experience per dose.
==Ranged boost by level==
Ranged boost is calculated with: <math>\lfloor RangedLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor + 4</math>

*[[Ranged]] will be boosted by 4 + 10% of the player's level (rounded down)
*[[Defence]] will be boosted by 5 + 15% of the player's level (rounded down).
*During these 5 minutes, the player's Ranged and Defence levels will not drain below the maximum boost of the potion.
Although natural stat drain is disabled, a player's stats can still be decreased or increased by the use of other spells and potions.
It is created by using [[crystal dust]] on a [[bastion potion]], requiring 86 [[Herblore]].
cases.rationale: Own Ranged/Defence boosts last 5 minutes and drinking costs 10 HP with survival threshold. Active boost with health cost supports potion, not Cleanup; no Boost Potion Share is a mechanical condition. Crystal-dust creation is upstream and all four exact states retained.

cases.title: Ancient brew
cases.semanticExcerpt: An '''ancient brew''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[nihil dust]] on an [[Dwarf weed potion (unf)|unfinished dwarf weed potion]], requiring 85 [[Herblore]], yielding an ancient brew(3) and 190 Herblore [[experience]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: A dose of ancient brew [[boost]]s the player's [[Magic]] level by 2 + 5% of their base Magic level, as well as restoring [[prayer points]] equal to 2 + 10% of their base [[Prayer]] level (with the ability to restore up to 5%, rounded down, over the player's base Prayer level). However, it will also drain the player's [[Attack]], [[Strength]], and [[Defence]] levels by 2 + 10% of their current levels.
secondaryExcerpts:
===Stat drain by level===
Attack/Strength/Defence drain is calculated with: <math display="inline">\left\lfloor\text{(Current Stat Level)} \times \frac{1}{10}\right\rfloor + 2</math>.

A dose of ancient brew [[boost]]s the player's [[Magic]] level by 2 + 5% of their base Magic level, as well as restoring [[prayer points]] equal to 2 + 10% of their base [[Prayer]] level (with the ability to restore up to 5%, rounded down, over the player's base Prayer level). However, it will also drain the player's [[Attack]], [[Strength]], and [[Defence]] levels by 2 + 10% of their current levels.

{{Potions}}
[[Category:Items storable in the potion storage]]
[[Category:Temporary skill boost]]
[[Category:Magic boosting items]]

===Prayer restore===
Prayer restore is calculated with: <math>\lfloor PrayerLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor + 2</math>

Stat boosts will decay at a rate of 1 point per minute, or 90 seconds with the use of [[Preserve]].

cases.title: Menaphite remedy
cases.semanticExcerpt:
A '''Menaphite remedy ''' is a stat renewal potion that restores 6 + 16% of the player's combat stats (excluding [[prayer]]) every 15 seconds, over the course of 5 minutes. This can be used to effectively negate the stat-draining effects of [[Saradomin brew|Saradomin brews]] and [[Armadyl brew|Armadyl Brews]].
[[File:Menaphite remedy.gif|thumb|left|150px|A Menaphite remedy slightly rejuvenates the player.]]
It can be made by a player with 88 [[Herblore]] by adding a [[Lily of the Sands]] to an [[Dwarf weed potion (unf)|unfinished dwarf weed potion]]. This grants the player 200 [[Herblore]] experience.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
A '''Menaphite remedy ''' is a stat renewal potion that restores 6 + 16% of the player's combat stats (excluding [[prayer]]) every 15 seconds, over the course of 5 minutes. This can be used to effectively negate the stat-draining effects of [[Saradomin brew|Saradomin brews]] and [[Armadyl brew|Armadyl Brews]].
[[File:Menaphite remedy.gif|thumb|left|150px|A Menaphite remedy slightly rejuvenates the player.]]
It can be made by a player with 88 [[Herblore]] by adding a [[Lily of the Sands]] to an [[Dwarf weed potion (unf)|unfinished dwarf weed potion]]. This grants the player 200 [[Herblore]] experience.
secondaryExcerpts: Additionally, consuming this potion will remove all [[Divine potion|divine]] effects of existing boosts, such as from the [[saturated heart]] or a [[divine super combat potion]], making them tick down at the usual rate of -1 level per 60 seconds (90 if praying [[Preserve]]).
Although this potion will restore combat stats if they are below their base level, it will not boost your combat stats back up if they were previously boosted.

This property can prolong the usefulness of these boosts by consuming the remedy at any point before the boost runs out. A stat boosted by a divine effect will return to its base level after the divine effect expires, but removing it with the Menaphite remedy will retain the boosted stat, allowing it to tick down normally.

If new divine boosts are applied '''after''' the remedy has been consumed, they will correctly apply their divine status. This strategy can be useful at a bank to prepare for scenarios where the player's stats are frequently lowered, such as [[Nex]], where Saradomin brews are often used. This allows the player to benefit from the stat restoration of the Menaphite remedy while retaining the benefits of their divine potions or saturated heart.

==Trivia==
* Though the potion was polled to require level 71 Herblore to make, it was increased to level 88 on release. In addition, it was polled to give 150 experience, but was increased to 200.

This strategy can be useful at a bank to prepare for scenarios where the player's stats are frequently lowered, such as [[Nex]], where Saradomin brews are often used. This allows the player to benefit from the stat restoration of the Menaphite remedy while retaining the benefits of their divine potions or saturated heart.

secondaryExcerpts: Additionally, consuming this potion will remove all [[Divine potion|divine]] effects of existing boosts, such as from the [[saturated heart]] or a [[divine super combat potion]], making them tick down at the usual rate of -1 level per 60 seconds (90 if praying [[Preserve]]).
Although this potion will restore combat stats if they are below their base level, it will not boost your combat stats back up if they were previously boosted.

This property can prolong the usefulness of these boosts by consuming the remedy at any point before the boost runs out. A stat boosted by a divine effect will return to its base level after the divine effect expires, but removing it with the Menaphite remedy will retain the boosted stat, allowing it to tick down normally.

cases.title: Sunlight moth mix
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''sunlight moth mix''' is a type of [[hunter's mix]] that players can drink to restore 6 + 20% of their reduced stats, as well as 8 [[Hitpoints]], but '''not''' including [[Prayer]]. If consumed in a [[multicombat area]], up to three players who are standing within two tiles of the drinker will receive the same effect, provided that they have [[Accept Aid]] toggled on. This effectively works as a cheaper [[Restore potion|restore]] potion, without requiring either [[Herblore]] levels or ingredients.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: A '''sunlight moth mix''' is a type of [[hunter's mix]] that players can drink to restore 6 + 20% of their reduced stats, as well as 8 [[Hitpoints]], but '''not''' including [[Prayer]]. If consumed in a [[multicombat area]], up to three players who are standing within two tiles of the drinker will receive the same effect, provided that they have [[Accept Aid]] toggled on. This effectively works as a cheaper [[Restore potion|restore]] potion, without requiring either [[Herblore]] levels or ingredients.
secondaryExcerpts: Similar to [[Guthix rest]], sunlight moth mix effectively functions as a potion, meaning players can use them to heal during combat without delaying their attacks. This makes them particularly useful for healing when attempting to kill bosses as quickly as possible for certain [[Combat Achievements|combat achievements]], especially when intentionally taking damage with [[vengeance]] and [[Ring of recoil|rings of recoil]].
They are made by using a jarred [[Sunlight moth (item)|sunlight moth]] with certain meats acquired from [[hunter creatures]]; doing so requires a [[pestle and mortar]], and has no skill requirements.

cases.title: Prayer regeneration potion
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''prayer regeneration potion''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[aldarium]] on a [[huasca potion (unf)]]. This requires level 58 [[Herblore]] and grants 132 Herblore experience.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: Each dose restores one [[Prayer points|Prayer point]] every 12 ticks for 8 minutes, restoring 66 Prayer points in total. Its effect is similar to that of a [[prayer enhance]] from the [[Chambers of Xeric]], but restores Prayer more slowly and lasts longer.
secondaryExcerpts: Unlike standard [[prayer potion]]s, prayer regeneration potions cannot be shared using [[Stat Restore Pot Share]] or made into a [[barbarian mix]].

As compared to similar potions (purchasing the 4-dose variant), at level 99 Prayer:
* Prayer regeneration potions cost {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Prayer regeneration potion(4)}}/4/66|c}} per Prayer point restored
* [[Prayer potions]] cost {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Prayer potion(4)}}/4/31|c}} per Prayer point restored
* [[Super restore]] potions cost {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Super restore(4)}}/4/32|c}} per Prayer point restored
* [[Zamorak brew]]s cost {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Zamorak brew(4)}}/4/10|c}} per Prayer point restored

The amount of Prayer restored is not affected by the [[holy wrench]], [[Prayer cape]], or [[ring of the gods (i)]]. However, the ring's high [[Prayer items|Prayer bonus]] can be useful in combination with the potion. With a Prayer bonus of at least +42, [[protection prayer]]s drain slowly enough for the potion's regeneration effect to offset their Prayer drain, allowing them to be maintained without additional [[prayer potion]]s.

Each dose restores one [[Prayer points|Prayer point]] every 12 ticks for 8 minutes, restoring 66 Prayer points in total. Its effect is similar to that of a [[prayer enhance]] from the [[Chambers of Xeric]], but restores Prayer more slowly and lasts longer.
{{Bug|Drinking a prayer regeneration potion puts the player into combat, preventing them from logging out for 10 seconds.}}
cases.rationale: Own recurring Prayer recovery, no wrench benefit and sharing/mixing restrictions support potion. Explicit bankable=Yes across four own IDs guards against broad raid/mode exclusions.

cases.title: Goading potion
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''goading potion''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[Aldarium]] on a [[harralander potion (unf)]], requiring 54 [[Herblore]] and granting 132 Herblore experience.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
==Mechanics==
The potion's effect runs on a cycle of 6 ticks (3.6 seconds) starting one tick after drinking; when a monster is in range on that tick, they will become aggressive towards the player.
secondaryExcerpts:
==Mechanics==
The potion's effect runs on a cycle of 6 ticks (3.6 seconds) starting one tick after drinking; when a monster is in range on that tick, they will become aggressive towards the player.

Before drinking the potion within proximity of multiple mid to high level monsters, always be prepared. Be mindful of different monsters whose wander zone may overlap with the intended target of the goading potion. For example, a player killing [[warped jellies]] in the [[Catacombs of Kourend]] may not have the [[facemask]] needed to handle the [[dust devils]] immediately to the south. The effect of the goading potion may be cancelled at any time by drinking a [[cup of tea]] or teleporting away.

==Trivia==
* The goading potion is based on the {{RSL|aggression potion}} from ''RuneScape 3'', albeit with different requirements and area of effect.

In [[single-way combat]], only one (non-aggressive) monster will start targeting the player once they are out of combat. The potion does not affect monsters who are already targeting another player or entity, nor will it affect monsters the player does not have the [[Slayer]] level to kill.
cases.rationale: Own consumption causes timed monster aggression with range, line-of-sight, Slayer-level and single-combat conditions. This active effect supports potion rather than Cleanup despite no healing. Tea/teleport cancellation and Aldarium recipe are distinct roles. Four exact dose states retained.

cases.title: Surge potion
cases.semanticExcerpt: A '''surge potion''' is an untradeable [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[demonic tallow]] on a [[torstol potion (unf)]], requiring 81 [[Herblore]] and granting 185 Herblore experience. Making the potion gives the game message {{mes|You mix the tallow with a bit of your blood into the potion.}}
secondaryExcerpts:
The cooldown timer can be removed in the following situations:
* [[Dying]] (including in safe minigames and when resurrected by diary perks)
* Entering and exiting a [[raid]] or the Fortis Colosseum
* Using the [[free-for-all portal]] in [[Ferox Enclave]]
* Drinking from any [[pool space|pool]] in a [[player-owned house]]

The cooldown timer '''will not''' pause or be removed during these situations:
* Between waves in the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]]
* Between rooms in the [[Tombs of Amascut]]
* Dying in the [[Chambers of Xeric]], [[Theatre of Blood]], or [[Tombs of Amascut]]
* Praying at the [[Elidinis Statuette]]
Attempting to drink the potion with 100% special attack energy will produce the message {{mes|Drinking this would have no effect.}}
cases.rationale: Own twenty-five-percent special-attack restore with five-minute cooldown supports potion. Storage inside Chambers does not imply exclusive use; PvP delay/cooldown exceptions are effect constraints. Four own doses retain.

cases.title: Extended stamina potion
cases.semanticExcerpt: An '''extended stamina potion''' restores 40% of the player's [[Energy|run energy]] per dose, and offers a 70% reduction in run energy depletion for 4 minutes. This effect does not stack, and drinking additional doses before the timer has run out will simply reset it back to 4 minutes. When the stamina effect is active the boot in the run energy orb changes from its usual yellow to orange.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: An '''extended stamina potion''' restores 40% of the player's [[Energy|run energy]] per dose, and offers a 70% reduction in run energy depletion for 4 minutes. This effect does not stack, and drinking additional doses before the timer has run out will simply reset it back to 4 minutes. When the stamina effect is active the boot in the run energy orb changes from its usual yellow to orange.
secondaryExcerpts: When used to charge the [[ring of endurance]], each dose grants two charges. Drinking a dose of extended stamina potion while having a charged ring of endurance equipped will consume 2 charges to double the potion's effect, restoring 80% run energy and granting the run energy depletion buff for 8 minutes.

An extended stamina potion can be made at level 85 [[Herblore]] by mixing a regular [[stamina potion]] with [[marlin scales]]. Each dose grants 27.5 Herblore experience, and requires one marlin scale.
cases.rationale: Own 40% run-energy restoration and 4-minute stamina effect support active potion. Ring-of-endurance charging is real competing use and charged-ring drinking doubles effect under stated conditions; primary remains consumed potion. Four exact doses retained.

cases.title: Armadyl brew
cases.semanticExcerpt: An '''Armadyl brew''' is a [[Herblore#Potions|potion]] made by using [[rainbow crab paste]] on an [[umbral potion (unf)|unfinished umbral potion]], requiring 89 [[Herblore]] and granting 205 Herblore [[experience]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: Each dose of an Armadyl brew temporarily lowers [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], and [[Magic]] by 10% + 2 of their current levels, and raises [[Hitpoints]] by 10% + 2 and [[Ranged]] by 10% + 4 of their base levels. This can boost the player's Hitpoints and Ranged above their base level by up to the amount restored.
secondaryExcerpts: Each dose of an Armadyl brew temporarily lowers [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], and [[Magic]] by 10% + 2 of their current levels, and raises [[Hitpoints]] by 10% + 2 and [[Ranged]] by 10% + 4 of their base levels. This can boost the player's Hitpoints and Ranged above their base level by up to the amount restored.

===Ranged boost by level===
Ranged boost is calculated with: <math>\lfloor RangedLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor + 4</math>

===Stat drain by level===
Attack/Strength/Defence/Magic drain is calculated with: <math display="inline">\left\lfloor\text{(Current Stat Level)} \cdot \frac{1}{10}\right\rfloor + 2</math>.
This is the same boost as a standard [[ranging potion]].

This heal is a boost to the Hitpoints skill and does allow for [[overhealing]] above the player's maximum Hitpoints.

==Effects==
===Hitpoints per dose===
The amount of Hitpoints healed is based on a player's base Hitpoints level. The formula is <math display="inline">\left\lfloor \text{Hitpoints} \cdot \frac{10}{100}\right\rfloor + 2</math>.

One dose of [[super restore]] is enough to restore lost stats from about three doses of Armadyl brew, or up to four doses of brew if the player's stats were boosted beforehand (as with a [[super combat potion]]).
cases.rationale: Own Ranged/Hitpoints boost with other-stat drains supports active brew. Herblore recipe and super-restore recovery synergy are secondary. Overhealing is explicit; retain all exact doses, not food or mode-only routing.

cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: Each dose of an Armadyl brew temporarily lowers [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], and [[Magic]] by 10% + 2 of their current levels, and raises [[Hitpoints]] by 10% + 2 and [[Ranged]] by 10% + 4 of their base levels. This can boost the player's Hitpoints and Ranged above their base level by up to the amount restored.
secondaryExcerpts: Each dose of an Armadyl brew temporarily lowers [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], and [[Magic]] by 10% + 2 of their current levels, and raises [[Hitpoints]] by 10% + 2 and [[Ranged]] by 10% + 4 of their base levels. This can boost the player's Hitpoints and Ranged above their base level by up to the amount restored.

===Ranged boost by level===
Ranged boost is calculated with: <math>\lfloor RangedLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor + 4</math>

===Stat drain by level===
Attack/Strength/Defence/Magic drain is calculated with: <math display="inline">\left\lfloor\text{(Current Stat Level)} \cdot \frac{1}{10}\right\rfloor + 2</math>.
This is the same boost as a standard [[ranging potion]].

This heal is a boost to the Hitpoints skill and does allow for [[overhealing]] above the player's maximum Hitpoints.

==Effects==
===Hitpoints per dose===
The amount of Hitpoints healed is based on a player's base Hitpoints level. The formula is <math display="inline">\left\lfloor \text{Hitpoints} \cdot \frac{10}{100}\right\rfloor + 2</math>.

One dose of [[super restore]] is enough to restore lost stats from about three doses of Armadyl brew, or up to four doses of brew if the player's stats were boosted beforehand (as with a [[super combat potion]]).
cases.rationale: Own Ranged/Hitpoints boost with other-stat drains supports active brew. Herblore recipe and super-restore recovery synergy are secondary. Overhealing is explicit; retain all exact doses, not food or mode-only routing.
